# Invented for tests. Not a real book. Cumulative structure.
=== page 1 ===
This is the seed that Hen found.
=== page 2 ===
This is the rain that fell on the seed that Hen found.
=== page 3 ===
This is the sun that warmed the rain that fell on the seed that Hen found.
=== page 4 ===
Do you see what grew? Can you guess?
=== page 5 ===
A sunflower, tall as a house! Hen sat in its shade and laughed.
